items.item: The form is split into titled sections (personal, job and contract, bank and tax, emergency contact, documents) in a single column, with a visible label above every field and no placeholder-only labels
items.evidence: Five titled sections exist (h2 '1. Thông tin cá nhân' ... '5. Giấy tờ') and every field has a visible label.lbl above it (placeholders are only examples). But fields are laid out in a 12-col grid (.grid-f with .c3/.c4/.c6 spans), three per row in the screenshot, so it is not a single column.

items.item: Required fields are marked consistently, and optional fields are labelled as optional or left unmarked by a stated convention
items.evidence: Required labels carry '*' plus aria-required; header states '* Bắt buộc'; optional fields (Quốc tịch, Ngày cấp, Chi nhánh, Mã số thuế, Phụ cấp) are unmarked by that convention.

items.item: Field widths match their content: dates, postal codes and tax codes are narrow; inputs use the right types (email, tel, date)
items.evidence: Types are right (type=date, type=email, type=tel). Widths are not differentiated: date inputs (dob, idDate, startDate) and tax code (#tax) use c4, the same width as name fields (~255px). Phone (c3) is somewhat narrower. No postal code field.

items.item: An option to save the form as a draft is offered, and saving a draft does not demand every required field
items.evidence: Button #draft 'Lưu nháp'; its handler only calls setBusy and shows 'Đã lưu nháp NV-0248' without calling validateAll.

items.item: Save and Cancel stay reachable while scrolling (a sticky bar or equivalent), Save is a verb label and is not disabled before submitting
items.evidence: Bar has 'sticky bottom-0' and is visible at the bottom of first.png with Hủy / Lưu nháp / 'Tiếp nhận nhân viên'. The label is a verb phrase. #save is disabled only while submitting (setBusy).

items.item: Fields validate on blur and on submit; with several errors a summary at the top links to each field and focus moves to the first invalid field
items.evidence: form 'focusout' listener runs setErr(check(el)); the submit handler calls validateAll(), then refreshSummary() (shown when 3 or more errors) builds links with data-jump and href=#id; first.focus() after scrollIntoView.

items.item: Leaving the page with unsaved input triggers a warning
items.evidence: window 'beforeunload' handler when dirty; in-app links and Hủy open #leaveDlg 'Bạn có thay đổi chưa lưu. Rời trang mà không lưu?'.

items.item: The document upload states accepted file types and the size limit, lists chosen files with a remove button, and is keyboard operable
items.evidence: #docNeed: 'Định dạng PDF, JPG, PNG; tối đa 10 MB mỗi tệp.'; table #docTable lists files with a 'Xóa' button (aria-label 'Xóa <name>'); native input#fileIn (sr-only) is focusable and its label shows focus-within outline; invalid type/size errors are shown.

items.item: Success is confirmed with a message that names the employee and is announced to assistive technology
items.evidence: toast('Nhân viên NV-0248 ' + name + ' đã được tiếp nhận') in #toast role=status. Caveat: the toast is toggled with the hidden attribute (display:none to shown), so some screen readers may not announce it reliably.

notes: Plain, restrained admin UI: white sidebar, 4-6px radii, no KPI tiles, gradients, glass or emoji. The only gradient is the hidden loading skeleton shimmer. The audit scored 96, with only table-above-fold flagged, which is irrelevant for a form. Main failures: multi-column grid instead of a single column, and uniform c4 widths for dates and tax code. Emergency-contact and document sections were not seen in a screenshot; judged from source only.
